display.title: The New Moon and the Molad: Shabbos Mevarchim Adar Sheini
display.summary_short: Before Shabbos Mevarchim Adar Sheini, Uncle Yossi explains how the moon grows each month, how the molad is calculated, and why a leap year brings a double portion of joy.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given the week of Shabbos Mevarchim for Adar Sheini. Uncle Yossi reminds children how the moon wanes to nothing at the end of the month and then reappears as a thin line that grows until the fifteenth. Our Sages, with their G-dly wisdom, set up a calendar that tells in advance the exact day, hour, minute and second of the molad, the birth of the new moon, which will be announced in shul that Shabbos. No clock on earth is as precise as the heavenly bodies; as Dovid HaMelech wrote in Tehillim, 'the heavens tell the glory of Hashem', and studying them fills us with yiras Shamayim. Since it is a leap year with two months of Adar, we get a double portion of joy, and he prays for the greatest joy of all, leaving golus with Moshiach.
display.lesson: The precise motion of the heavens shows Hashem's greatness and brings us to yiras Shamayim.
